name: get_host_shell
description: Return the host shell executable and default working directory.

name: run_host_shell
description: Run a command in a fresh noninteractive /bin/sh on the shared host, with no live stdin. By default return its outcome, stream descriptions, full log paths, and supported stdout images. With background=true return an activity_id; a later text callback with the same ID reports completion or interruption to this session. Background image results include descriptions and paths without native images. Commands stop with this runtime; remaining processes in a command's group are stopped when that command ends.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or relative to Ivenna's startup directory (the default).

timeout_ms.description: Command timeout in milliseconds. Omit for 600000 (10 minutes).

interpretation.description: Present complete nonempty stdout text as an image URL. Omit for automatic byte detection.

background.description: Run independently of this activation and receive a completion observation. Omit or use false to wait for the result.
